purpose: User-selected published portfolio work is the primary editorial craft benchmark for Content Studio. Derive original lessons about voice, narrative and structure; do not reproduce third-party publication text or unverified claims.
status: Five published portfolio references are indexed by URL and editorial craft annotations. Full article text, PDFs and video transcripts have not been ingested, so full-text voice matching is not yet available.

grading_policy.standard: Portfolio-led B2B journalistic craft with AP-informed US English
criteria: Journalistic hook grounded in a meaningful business tension
Nut graf by paragraphs 3-5 in substantial narrative formats
Evidence discipline, transparent attribution and no fabricated reporting
Distinctive analogy, pacing or explanatory craft where appropriate
grading_policy.limits: Grade against these explicitly documented portfolio-derived craft attributes, not purported textual similarity to source documents.
